approval_evidence.quote: Our STN: BL 125731/0 BLA APPROVAL AND BLA ACCELERATED APPROVAL Wyeth Pharmaceuticals LLC ... June 10, 2021 ... Pneumococcal 20-valent Conjugate Vaccine. We also refer to our approval letter dated June 8, 2021

series_start_reason: Pfizer printed Prevnar 13/Prevenar 13 as its own line through the second quarter 2021 release and no Prevnar 20 line at any time. From the third-quarter 2021 release the line is renamed 'Prevnar family' and its footnote adds Prevnar 20 (adult). The series therefore starts 2021Q3, the first quarter the Prevnar 20 revenue is inside a printed line; earlier 'Prevnar 13/Prevenar 13' quarters are a different definition and are not spliced. Prevnar 20 approval in the U.S.: June 2021.
search_log: listed PFE (CIK 0000078003) 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K via data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages): 6671 filings; selected 8-Ks with Item 2.02 filed 2015-01 to 2026-08 (53, of which 48 carry an EX-99.1 earnings release; 2022-04-20, 2023-10-13 and 2023-12-14 filings are not quarterly earnings releases; the 2016-02-16 8-K/A carries no usable product table and the original 2016-02-02 release was used)

parsed every release's product tables with scripts/extract.py; quarter row = first occurrence of the product row, year-to-date row = third occurrence (or second where sub-region tables are absent); checked by summing quarters to the printed twelve-month figure

no separate Prevnar 20 revenue line exists in any earnings release 2021-2026 (all rows beginning 'Prev' extracted from every release); recorded the 'Prevnar family' line (Prevnar 13 + Prevnar 20, pediatric and adult) as Product family; Prevnar 13 volume is included, so the series overstates Prevnar 20 alone

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: Listed Pfizer (CIK 78003) 10-Q/8-K 2021-06 to 2022-09 and FY2021 10-K.; US FDA approval June 2021 (10-Q Q2 and Q3 2021); CDC ACIP recommendation October 2021 (Q3 2021 10-Q); Q1 2022 10-Q: "strong retail and wholesaler stocking in the U.S. of Prevnar 20 for the adult indication". Q3 2021 10-Q footnote first includes Prevnar 20 (adult) in the Prevnar family line, which suggests but does not state sales in Q3 2021.; No Pfizer document found stating a launch or first-shipment date for Prevnar 20, so launch_quarter is null.
